title: Kissed by Clay Thai Papaya Som-Tum
description: A refreshing Thai papaya som-tum dish served in a clay tajine vessel, featuring anti-inflammatory ingredients and a tangy flavor profile.
instructions: In a clay tajine vessel, combine papaya, tamarind paste, fish sauce, chili peppers, garlic, and palm sugar.
Mash the mixture with a spoon or the back of a fork until it reaches your desired consistency.
Add fresh cilantro and stir to combine.
Squeeze lime juice over the top and season with salt to taste.
Cover the vessel with a lid and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, sprinkle with additional cilantro and serve with crispy shallots and toasted peanuts (optional).
Serve immediately, garnished with chopped cilantro and a side of steamed jasmine rice.
For an added crunch, top with diced Granny Smith apple.
Adjust seasoning as needed and serve chilled.
